items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Seat belt pretensioner can burst in a crash (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Transmission can slip out of Park from wet wiring (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Instrument display can go blank on the Electrified GV70 (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer

items.t: Loss of power from a punctured intercooler radiator
items.job: Replace intercooler radiator and refill coolant; replace intercooler water pump if it ran dry
items.note: Owners report paying about $2,200 for the intercooler radiator and over $2,500 when the pump was also replaced. Dealers have treated it as road damage, so check your comprehensive insurance. For comparison, RepairPal puts a main radiator replacement at about $1,937-$2,295.

items.t: Check engine light for the intercooler coolant pump
items.job: Diagnose and repair the intercooler electric water pump per bulletin 25-01-062G
items.note: Normally done free under Genesis's 5-year/60,000-mile basic warranty.

items.t: Scraping noise and stalling from torque converter damage
items.job: Replace torque converter
items.note: Should be covered by Genesis's powertrain warranty on these model years.

items.t: Misfire and check engine light on cold starts (2.5 turbo)
items.job: Engine computer update per bulletin 25-01-051G
items.note: If spark plugs are needed, RepairPal estimates about $402-$510 for a GV70.

items.t: AWD warning from the transfer case actuator
items.job: Diagnose and repair transfer case actuator per bulletin 23-DS-002G
items.note: Check warranty coverage first.

items.t: Hum or whine from the rear differential
items.job: Inspect and retighten rear differential lock nut; replace parts if needed

items.t: Forward collision system brakes for no reason
items.job: Driver-assist diagnosis and front sensor calibration
items.note: Parts extra if a sensor has failed.

items.t: Cracks in the side sill panels
items.job: Repair side sill cracks with epoxy and undercoating per service campaign 23-01-001G
items.note: Free under Genesis service campaign T23G for 2022 GV70s built March 10 to August 9, 2021. The bulletin allows 0.9 hours for one side and 1.1 hours for both; the inspection alone is 0.2 hours. Check your VIN with a Genesis retailer.

items.t: Squeak from the rear suspension
items.job: Inspect and reseat rear coil spring

items.t: Infotainment update doesn't finish
items.job: Check and complete navigation software update

items.t: Center screen flickers or goes blank
items.job: Adjust display video cable connector shield
items.note: Normally done free under Genesis's 5-year/60,000-mile basic warranty.

items.t: Center console cover peels
items.job: Inspect and replace floor console assembly
items.note: Normally done free under Genesis's 5-year/60,000-mile basic warranty.

items.t: Steering wheel call button sticks
items.job: Replace steering wheel call button cover per service campaign 24-01-028G
items.note: Free under Genesis service campaign T38G for 2024 GV70s built May 10 to August 30, 2023 and 2023-2024 Electrified GV70s built January 25 to August 28, 2023. The bulletin allows 0.3 hours. The button cover price is not published, so parts are shown as covered.

items.t: Electrified GV70 stops charging
items.job: Charge management software update

items.t: Brake lights and i-Pedal software update
items.job: Vehicle control unit software update

items.t: Door trim panel coming apart
items.job: Inspect and replace door trim panels
items.note: Normally done free under Genesis's 5-year/60,000-mile basic warranty.

items.t: Check engine light from the active air flap sensor
items.job: Replace active air flap sensors
items.note: Normally done free under Genesis's 5-year/60,000-mile basic warranty.

items.t: Genesis Connected Services stop working
items.job: Infotainment (AVN) reset

items.t: Damaged rear floor panel from the factory
items.job: Sand and undercoat rear floor panel
items.note: Normally done free under Genesis's 5-year/60,000-mile basic warranty.

items.t: Coolant loss from the thermal management module
items.job: Coolant leak diagnosis; repair or replace thermal management module
items.note: RepairPal puts a GV70 coolant leak diagnosis at about $61-$90. The module itself should be a warranty repair on cars this new.
